description: This file defines an Akka actor class 'ThingUpdater' responsible for handling persistence updates for a specific 'thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages state related to the thing's ID, revision, and associated policies, processes various incoming messages such as events, tags, policy references, and update responses, and enqueues metadata for persistence updates.

classes.name: ThingUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for managing persistence updates for a specific 'Thing' entity, handling incoming events, tags, policy references, update commands, and responses, and enqueuing metadata for downstream processing.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props configuration for initializing a ThingUpdater actor with given pubSubMediator and changeQueueActor references.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, supporting processing of various message types and timeout handling.

methods.name: stopThisActor
methods.description: Handles timeout events to stop and passivate the actor.

methods.name: exportMetadata
methods.description: Exports the current metadata state of the actor for persistence purposes.

methods.name: enqueueMetadata
methods.description: Enqueues the current metadata state to the change queue actor.

methods.name: enqueueMetadata
methods.description: Enqueues provided metadata to the change queue actor.

methods.name: processThingTag
methods.description: Processes incoming 'ThingTag' messages, updates internal state if revision is newer, and enqueues metadata.

methods.name: updateThing
methods.description: Handles requests to update the search index for the associated thing.

methods.name: processUpdateThingResponse
methods.description: Processes responses to update requests, logging warnings and re-enqueueing metadata if needed.

methods.name: processPolicyReferenceTag
methods.description: Processes incoming policy reference tags, updates internal policy state if revision is newer, and enqueues metadata.

methods.name: processThingEvent
methods.description: Processes 'ThingEvent' messages to update revision state and metadata if the event is newer.

methods.name: tryToGetThingId
methods.description: Attempts to determine the ThingId based on the actor's name URL decoding.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Decodes the actor's name to derive the ThingId.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment message back to the sender if not dead letters.
